t: Rewrite gardener to militantly remediate spokes to GREEN with per-spoke execution logging
challenge: Gardener does superficial health checks but doesn't remediate. 11/17 spokes RED, 1/31 skills installed on basher. No per-spoke execution logs — can't diagnose what happened.
hypothesis: If the gardener runs a 4-phase protocol (diagnose→remediate→verify→log) with explicit remediation mappings from health check failures to template copy operations, and writes per-spoke execution logs, then spokes will be brought to GREEN and failures will be traceable.
perceive: 1. Read hub/.claude/agents/ozi-gardener.md — current remediation is one teaching check. 2. Read hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scripts/wheel-tender.sh — no log directory, no spoke log aggregation. 3. Run spoke_health_check.py on basher to see actual failure output format. 4. Read templates/spoke/.claude/settings.json for template hook structure. 5. Read templates/spoke/skills/WAI-Skills.jsonl for full skill list (31 entries).
execute: 1. Create hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/logs/.gitkeep. 2. Update wheel-tender.sh: add SPOKE_LOG_DIR, mkdir, pass log path in prompt, add log rotation. 3. Rewrite ozi-gardener.md: add framework template paths, replace Step 1 with 4-phase remediation (diagnose/remediate/verify/log), add check-ID-to-fix mapping table, add skill sync protocol (additive only), add settings.json merge rules, add per-spoke log format, change execution model (parent remediates, subagents only for work), add git commit after remediation. 4. Update fleet report format with remediation data.
verify: 1. bash -n on wheel-tender.sh. 2. Run on basher: check logs/basher-{date}.log exists with before/after health. 3. Verify basher skills increased from 1 toward 31. 4. Verify basher health improved from YELLOW toward GREEN. 5. passes.jsonl has token usage. 6. Report has remediation_actions per spoke.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Task to make the gardener militant about spoke compliance — map every health check failure to a specific remediation action, log everything, verify results
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not about changing what the health check detects — spoke_health_check.py is fine. This is about making the gardener ACT on what it finds.
